changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Corrected stale release wording and documented the pinned vLLM structured-output limitation.
changes.details: The image digest, source commit, launch arguments, and Candidate qualification are unchanged. The runtime is now described as an exact development image for the released model, and reasoning combined with JSON-schema structured output is explicitly unsupported.

changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Initial executable Pending single-Spark release for Muse Glimmer 30B BF16 text-and-image serving.
changes.details: Binds Meta's exact public checkpoint to the official Muse-specific vLLM CUDA 13 ARM64 image, dedicated reasoning and tool parsers, offline local model hydration, and a read-only local image-input contract. The 32K context and one-sequence limit preserve unified-memory headroom until a physical GB10 multimodal canary supports raising them.
